text:
MetLife Stadium mepere na April 10, 2010 dị ka New Meadowlands Stadium, na-ewere ọnọdụ ya na Meadowlands Sports Complex ebe ọ nọchiri Giants Stadium, nke guzoro site na 1976 ruo 2010. Ewubere ya na ihe dị ka US$1.6 ijeri ma kwado ya n'onwe ya site na nwe nke New York Giants na New York Jets, ọ bụ ama egwuregwu kacha ọnụ na United States n'oge emechara ya. N'afọ na-esote nkwekọrịta ikike aha gbanwere njirimara ya: n'okpuru nkwekọrịta afọ 25 bịanyere aka na August 23, 2011, New Meadowlands Stadium ghọrọ MetLife Stadium.

E chepụtara ebe ahụ dị ka ụlọ nkekọrịta maka ụlọ ọrụ NFL abụọ, Giants na Jets — nhazi pụrụ iche nke egosipụtara na nhazi ya. Onye na-ese ụkpụrụ bụ 360 Architecture, na-arụ ọrụ na EwingCole, Rockwell Group na Bruce Mau Design, ma na-amụba mpụta na-anọpụ iche nke ọ bụla n'ụcha otu ụlọ ọrụ ka ọ nwee ike ịbụ nke otu ọ bụla na-egwu. Nwe na-aga site na usoro New Jersey Sports and Exposition Authority.

Site na mmalite MetLife ka e wuru iji nabata ihe omume n'ọkwa kachasị ukwuu, ma ihe ndị ọ rụzuru gbasara koodu. Na bọọlụ America ọ mere Super Bowl XLVIII na February 2, 2014, ebe Seattle meriri Denver 43–8 — Super Bowl mbụ nke oyi na-emeghe, na okpomọkụ kickoff dị ihe dị ka 49°F. Na bọọlụ mba ụwa ọ nabatara 2016 Copa América Centenario ikpeazụ, nke Chile meriri Argentina 4–2 na penariti.

Ọnọdụ ya na egwuregwu ụwa na-ejedebe na 2026 World Cup. FIFA họọrọ ama egwuregwu ahụ iji nabata ikpeazụ nke asọmpi na July 19, 2026, ma ọ ga-eme egwuregwu asatọ n'ozuzu. Iji zute ihe achọrọ nke ihe omume ahụ, a gbanwere ala egwuregwu site na turf artificial gaa na Bermudagrass eke — mgbanwe nke gbanwere ebe e wuru maka gridiron ka ọ bụrụ ebe kwesịrị ekwesị maka egwuregwu bọọlụ kachasị ukwuu n'ụwa.
